description_en: Queries the authentication status of an active stream
description_zh: 查询当前在线流的鉴权
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-stream-auth-checking --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --url http://example.com/live/test.flv0auth_key=1664248000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveStreamAuthChecking

parameters.help_en: The ingest domain or streaming domain
parameters.help_zh: 直播推流域名或播流域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The complete ingest or streaming URL. You can use the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197400.html to generate a URL
parameters.help_zh: 完整的推流地址或播放地址。您可用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197400.html生成
parameters.name: url

Description.description_en: The error message returned if authentication failed
Description.description_zh: 鉴权不通过的错误信息

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the authentication is passed.

pass: The authentication is passed.

false: The authentication failed
Status.description_zh:
鉴权是否有效。
pass：有效。
false：无效
